tips.keluhan_utama: Explore the chief complaint with an open-ended question.
tips.rps: Ask about onset, duration, location, quality, and aggravating or relieving factors (OLD CART).
tips.rpd: Look for similar prior illness, allergies, and past procedures.
tips.rpk: Focus on infectious risks (such as TB) or inherited disease (such as hypertension or diabetes).
tips.sosial: Ask about work, diet, smoking, and the home environment.

about.description: PRIMER (Primary Care Manager Simulator) is a primary care management simulation built to train clinical decision-making and operational leadership for health professionals and students. Grounded in minimum service standards, patient safety, and quality assurance, it challenges players to manage SKDI-aligned patient care, synchronize family intervention data, and keep a clinic operating efficiently. It also helps general audiences understand the National Health System and the complexity of building ideal community health services.

history.event: Core concept development for an RPG-flavored primary care management simulator.
Clinical standards (SKDI) and national programs (PIS-PK / Prolanis) were integrated into gameplay.
Official copyright registration with the Ministry of Law of the Republic of Indonesia (No. EC002026019623).
v0.8.5 - Stability and hardening pass, including Lint Stability Pack and PRIMERA v5.0 Watchdog Mode.
Cloud deployment (Supabase + Vercel), security hardening, and anti-cheat systems.

objectives: Strengthen clinic leadership and management skills.
Integrate patient safety principles and minimum service standards.
Support quality assurance through SKDI-aligned clinical accuracy.
Provide practical understanding of the National Health System.
Train efficient and accurate clinical decision-making.
Help the public understand the flow of primary care services.

footer.thanks: Thank you for contributing to public health
